_comment: Freeform OS base commands — present on every distro. Custom Freeform commands are prefixed with /. These descriptions feed /help. The scanner adds any other executable found on the live system's PATH.
/help: List every available command and what it does (this screen).
/distro: Show or switch the loaded distro (reopens the loader).
freefetch: Show the Freeform logo with live system specs (fastfetch-style).
neofetch: Alias of freefetch — system info with logo.
find: Search for files in a directory tree.
kill: Send a signal to a process.
ping: Test network reachability of a host.
ip: Show / configure network interfaces and routes.
ssh: Connect to a remote machine over SSH.
sudo: Run a command as another user (usually root).
